protocol.accuracy_ties: retain all exact ties using sum of correct counts across three equal 114-case test sets; no metric tie-break
protocol.decision_rule: argmax of one final probability array in source-class order [0,1]; ties choose first column, malignant source class 0
protocol.exact_sampler_resume_supported: integer sampler seed reproduces each circuit; COBYLA internal optimizer state is not serializable for exact continuation
protocol.global_rngs: numpy.random.seed(initialization_seed), qiskit_algorithms.utils.algorithm_globals.random_seed and qiskit_machine_learning.utils.algorithm_globals.random_seed set per fit; initial point from separate default_rng(initialization_seed)
protocol.historical_differences: explicit reverse_linear RealAmplitudes connectivity and final layer; ansatz reps 1 and 2 versus historical reps 1; 3 declared seed pairs with explicit uniform initial vectors versus uncontrolled defaults; explicit shots 1024 and cross entropy; training-only preprocessing
protocol.incomplete_configurations: mean/std/min/max and mean clinical metrics unavailable until all three valid outcomes exist; show counts, failures and partial outcomes separately; excluded from shortlist
protocol.interpretation: basis_state % 2 (least-significant measured bit), not Hamming-weight parity; OneHotEncoder sorts source classes [0,1]; column 0 malignant
protocol.interruption_rule: preserve interrupted attempt and restart from original saved vector and seed pair under a new attempt ID; never resume from final angles alone
protocol.maxiter_meaning: SciPy 1.15 COBYLA maxiter is passed as maxfun, the maximum number of function evaluations
protocol.primary_ranking: mean test accuracy of exactly three valid seed outcomes
protocol.sampler_rng: fresh StatevectorSampler(default_shots=1024, seed=integer sampler_seed) per fit; installed implementation resets default_rng(integer_seed) per bound circuit; common random uniforms across samples and evaluations preserved
protocol.technical_retry_rule: at most one automatic retry for OSError, MemoryError, TimeoutError, BrokenProcessPool or serialization/I/O failure; preserved new attempt; no retry for budget exhaustion, poor scores, numerical validation or scientific failures
protocol.test_access: test inputs attach only after fitting; final predict_proba once per fit on test; all labels/predictions derived from that array; no test-driven training changes
